content.title: ‘The Lincoln Lawyer’ Season 5 Release Date Is Closer Than You Think
content.text: The Lincoln LawyerNetflixI think we can stop calling The Lincoln Lawyer a “sleeper hit” at this point, given that we are four seasons in and the show is actually now increasing in viewership. It not only has a season 5 greenlight, but production is actually starting as we speak, filming in LA. This was announced by creator and co-showrunner Ted Humphrey on Instagram:“We’ve just begun shooting Season 5 of #TheLincolnLawyer! And it’s going to fly by and land on @Netflix before you know it!”If production starts now, we can sketch out a pretty accurate picture of The Lincoln Lawyer season 5’s release date here. The Lincoln Lawyer season 4 began production on February 7, 2025, and was released exactly a year later on February 5, 2026. So, the obvious math here is that a year from today is March 2027, approximately 13 months after season 4.PROMOTEDIf that holds, it will be shorter than the gaps between seasons 2 and 3 and 3 and 4, which were 14.5 and 15.5 months, respectively. Netflix is trying to slim it down to a yearly release, as it is constantly criticized for long waits between seasons, sometimes pushing three years for shows like Wednesday and Stranger Things. That also just happened with a yawning 2.5-year gap between seasons of One Piece, which seems to have led to a decline in viewership. Now, production is beginning much faster on that series to avoid that again, and it’s looking like a year and a half. We also know that the aforementioned Wednesday season 3 started production much earlier and is also going for a 1.5 gap.The Lincoln LawyerNetflixMORE FOR YOUA similar show doing what The Lincoln Lawyer is doing is the Emmy-winning The Diplomat, which went from a year between seasons 1 and 2 down to 11.5 months between seasons 2 and 3, almost unheard of on Netflix for an hour-long drama like that.The Lincoln Lawyer hasn’t pushed itself into Netflix’s top 10 most-watched shows list or anything, but it’s a consistent, breezy hit, one that can be made more quickly than most on a lower budget than most, and that seems like it’s going to continue indefinitely. There are eight Lincoln Lawyer books by Michael Connelly, and if it makes it through them all, that would make The Lincoln Lawyer one of the longest-running Netflix dramas ever. We’ll see how things are by 2030, if this new schedule can hold.
